# Bundled archive tool

7-Zip Extra 26.04, released 2026-10-05. The unmodified Windows x64 `7za.exe` is used for ZIP and 7z listing and extraction. Orbit never executes an archive's contents.

- Official downloads: https://www.7-zip.org/download.html
- Binary distribution: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.04/7z2604-extra.7z
- Corresponding source: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/tag/26.04
- Executable SHA-256: `15D4C788C148E3677E2FC1C4A01F191FB6669EBA4F6ACF8A465F0F1A6F1E1260`

See `License.txt` for the GNU LGPL and BSD license notices. `readme.txt` is supplied from the same distribution. The executable and these notices are copied to `resources/7zip` beside the packaged application, outside `app.asar`.
